posts.title: Making a video series about AI risk, with AI
posts.description: How I turned seven arguments about AI risk into seven short animated films in Icelandic and English in about two days, with a cloned voice, a few hundred generated images, and a set of agents doing most of the production while I approved three things.

posts.title: A percolation screensaver
posts.description: The bootstrap percolation animation from the front page of this site, rebuilt as a native macOS screensaver with six color themes and a proper configuration sheet.

posts.title: Turning recorded D&D sessions into comics
posts.description: A small pipeline that records a session on a Zoom H1 Essential, transcribes the Icelandic audio with ElevenLabs, and renders each session as a graphic novel with gpt-image-2 and a set of reference images that keep the cast looking consistent across pages.
